# Dr. Itauma Itauma

## Data Scientist · Professor · Researcher · Academic Leader

**Associate Professor of Data Science and Analytics**  
Harrisburg University of Science and Technology

I study how **data, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytical methods** can be used to generate better evidence, support better decisions, and improve outcomes across education, health, and human-centered systems.

## INSIGHT Lab

### Interdisciplinary Network for Science, Intelligence, Growth, Health & Technology

> **Turning data into insight. Turning insight into impact.**

The emerging INSIGHT Lab brings together research in artificial intelligence, data science, education, health analytics, and advanced quantitative methods.

The vision is to create a collaborative research community where faculty, doctoral students, graduate researchers, and external partners can pursue rigorous, reproducible, and human-centered scholarship.

[Explore the INSIGHT Lab →](lab.qmd)

:::

## Teaching & Doctoral Mentorship

### ANLY 735 – Research Seminar in Predictive AI

A research-centered seminar exploring current developments in machine learning and predictive artificial intelligence, with emphasis on scholarly literature, critical evaluation, research communication, and emerging technologies.

### ANLY 799 – Doctoral Studies

Doctoral research mentorship focused on helping emerging scholars develop theoretically grounded, methodologically rigorous, reproducible, and impactful research.

[Explore Teaching →](teaching.qmd)

## About My Work

My scholarship spans artificial intelligence, data science, education and learning analytics, health and wellness analytics, and advanced quantitative methods. I am particularly interested in research that connects rigorous analytical methods with meaningful human, educational, organizational, and health outcomes.

I also mentor doctoral researchers and emerging scholars in developing research that is theoretically grounded, methodologically sound, reproducible, and positioned to make a practical contribution.

[Learn More About Me →](about.qmd)
